item.title: Firefox 148 Launches with AI Kill Switch Feature and More Enhancements
item.description:
📝 Firefox 148 Launches with Exciting AI Kill Switch Feature and More Enhancements. Beyond the AI kill switch, Firefox 148 offers users more control over remote updates, allowing them to opt out while still minimizing data collection. Users can set these preferences under Settings > Privacy & Settings > Firefox Data Collection.
🔗 Read more: https://serverhost.com/blog/firefox-148-launches-with-exciting-ai-kill-switch-feature-and-more-enhancements/

item.title: Show HN: enveil – hide your .env secrets from prAIng eyes
item.description:
📝 This isn’t theoretical. enveil solves this by ensuring plaintext secrets never exist on disk at all. Run your app enveil run -- npm start enveil run -- python manage.
